description: Machine-readable registry for local project skills. Inspired by Project Golem's skill registry concept, but scoped to this Python pipeline.

skills.name: Market Analysis Memory
skills.trigger: Use before generating or evaluating daily market analysis.
skills.output_contract: Prior prediction context, concrete institutional behavior, valid/low-sample YouTube learning rules.

skills.name: Stock History Card
skills.trigger: Use before naming prediction_targets or when auditing a ticker's historical hit-rate and triggers.
skills.output_contract: Prediction-first research-stock card: hit-rate, multi-horizon results, triggers, stops. Not for audience packaging.

skills.name: Event Radar
skills.trigger: Use when the workflow needs to decide whether an external event is material enough to affect the report or packaging.
skills.output_contract: Event score, Taiwan impact mapping, gate decision, and a compact reason the event matters.

skills.name: News Extraction
skills.trigger: Use when fetched news URLs need clean article text and source quality checks before analysis.
skills.output_contract: Clean article text, source metadata, source-quality verdict, and a Taiwan stock relevance note.

skills.name: YouTube Title Packaging
skills.trigger: Use when generating two YouTube title candidates or evaluating title performance.
skills.output_contract: Exactly two title candidates, A/B evaluation threshold, high-weight formulas.

skills.name: Transcript Mining
skills.trigger: Use when reviewing YouTube transcripts for hooks, repeated phrases, and structural patterns.
skills.output_contract: Transcript summary, hook lines, repeated phrases, and a section map.

skills.name: Thumbnail A/B Testing
skills.trigger: Use when building thumbnail prompts or deciding whether to replace a thumbnail.
skills.output_contract: Two visually distinct thumbnail concepts with exact visible text and 900-view sample rule.

skills.name: Thumbnail QC
skills.trigger: Use when thumbnails are rendered or need a readability and distinctness check before publishing.
skills.output_contract: Readability verdict, A/B distinctness check, and one concrete fix if the thumbnail is weak.

skills.name: Weekly Special Planning
skills.trigger: Use when a weekend or weekly special needs a thesis that maps a macro or commodity theme back to Taiwan stocks.
skills.output_contract: Weekly thesis, one supporting data story, one Taiwan stock bridge, one follow-up verification point, and a title direction.

skills.name: NotebookLM Cover Alignment
skills.trigger: Use when preparing NotebookLM source material or aligning first-slide cover guidance.
skills.output_contract: Cover-first instruction with title lines, date label, and visual theme alignment.
